blocks.text: The Philippines hurdled the second round of voting for the 2026 Miss Grand International pageant’s “Country’s Power of the Year” online poll, and is moving on to Round 3. But if in the first two rounds the public had 48 hours to vote, this time the voting period will only run for 24 hours. The third round of voting started on Wednesday, Sept. 30, at 9 P.M. (PST), and will close on Thursday, Oct. 1, at 9 P.M. (PST). What also makes the third round a tighter race for the qualifiers is the removal of the social media component for voting. […]...
